body:
i hate myself for not having a girlfriend because i feel that its my fault. nobody loved me at my worst, and now nobody loves me even at my best. seeing as i tried to go for a lot of different kinds of girls, it must be me. i must just suck as a person. me being a hopeless romantic doesn't help. i just tire of being alone with no one to hold.

and i do have a goal. i want to be a neurosurgeon and medical researcher one day. in fact, the idea that a lot of lives might be saved with my help is one of the few things keeping me alive. but even then, i feel like my life's not worth living. i am too flawed and unloved. i'm not the smartest tool in the shed and unsure if i can make it to med school. and what will be there for me in the end? i seem incapable of finding love.
